department: Computer Science and Software Engineering department

deadline.value: PhD enrolment at UC can begin on the first day of any month of the year; UC Doctoral Scholarships close 15 May 2027 for a second-half 2027 start.
deadline.quote: You may begin your PhD on the first day of any month of the year.

also.quote: for students planning to start in the second half of 2027; opens 20 March, closes 15 May

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: You must contact a potential supervisor before applying, and written evidence of their agreement must be included in the myUC application.
supervisor.quote: PhD students must contact a potential supervisor before applying.

also.quote: This evidence of supervision must be included in your application in myUC for your application to be assessed.

funding.value: The department scholarship gives tuition for thesis enrolment at the domestic rate, and the highest-ranked applicants also get a stipend.
funding.quote: The highest-ranked applicants are offered a stipend of NZ$28,000 per 120 points of thesis enrolment

also.quote: Applications for the scholarship must be made to the Administration of the Department.

entry_route.value: A research-focused honours or master's degree at First or Second Class Division I level is needed, so both routes are accepted.
entry_route.quote: Enrolment in a PhD requires completion of a research-focused honours or master’s degree, at First or Second Class (Division I) Honours or Distinction level (or equivalent qualifications).

notes: Department doctoral scholarship regulations are dated October 2022 on the PDF and should be confirmed with the department.
